name: TaxLens
tagline: Most expense apps are built for tracking spending
description: Most expense apps are built for tracking spending. TaxLens is built for tax compliance — and that's a completely different job. If you're a freelancer, contractor, or small business owner, you know the pain: receipts piling up, manual categorization, panic at tax time, and that nagging fear of an audit you're not ready for. TaxLens turns your camera into an AI accountant: Snap any receipt — paper, digital, multi-language, multi-format — and TaxLens extracts merchant, date, totals, tax, tips, and
